items.title: Non-life run-off deals reach 25 and $3.46bn so far in 2026: PwC
items.summary: PwC's Q3 2026 review shows ten publicly disclosed non-life run-off transactions involving $2.6 billion in gross liabilities, led largely by RiverStone International and QBE Insurance Group.

items.title: Cadillac Formula 1 sale talk is a private credit warning for UK life insurers
items.summary: Reports that billionaire Mark Walter is seeking a buyer for the Cadillac Formula 1 team highlight private credit and governance risks that have drawn close scrutiny from the UK Prudential Regulation Authority.

items.title: UK finance chiefs say DB schemes remain time-consuming
items.summary: Research from Standard Life reveals that nearly three quarters of senior finance decision-makers at UK businesses with a defined benefit scheme consider the time spent managing it to be significant.

items.title: The Fidelis Partnership announces plans for Singapore reinsurance expansion
items.summary: The Fidelis Partnership plans to launch a new Lloyd's service company in Singapore to handle treaty reinsurance.

items.title: AllianceBernstein appoints Sharon Duah as European ETF specialist
items.summary: Sharon Duah joins AllianceBernstein from Citi to drive the firm's exchange-traded fund strategy across Europe.

items.title: T. Rowe Price appoints Davide Costa as senior ETF specialist
items.summary: T. Rowe Price has appointed Davide Costa as a senior ETF specialist to expand its European footprint.
